contentHtml:
Corporate PRO services in Dubai involve delegating your company's visa processing, trade licensing, labour compliance, and document attestation to UAE authorities to a provider offering government liaison services.

There are different authorities and online systems for visa applications, renewals, work permits, trade license requirements, establishment records, attestations, and government correspondence. Moreover, businesses also need to account for closer corporate tax registration checks around licensing, the UAE's WPS compliance threshold increasing from 80% to 85%, and the continued shift toward digital government transactions through UAE Pass. These changes make accurate documentation and timely submissions more important for companies managing employees, licenses, and government approvals.

Corporate PRO support brings these tasks under one service arrangement so your internal teams can focus on daily operations while a specialist manages the required government procedures on your behalf.

What are Corporate PRO Services in Dubai?

Corporate PRO services in Dubai are professional government liaison services provided to businesses for managing recurring government transactions, documentation, licensing, immigration, labour procedures, and related compliance requirements.

A corporate PRO acts on behalf of your company to coordinate government-facing processes such as:

  • employee visa applications
  • renewals
  • work permits
  • trade license procedures
  • establishment card matters
  • document attestation
  • government correspondence

How Corporate PRO Services Differ From Individual PRO Services

What's New in 2026: Regulatory Changes Every Business Should Know

The 3 latest developments include:

  • Corporate tax registration is now linked to trade license renewal
  • WPS compliance threshold change
  • UAE PASS and the shift to digital PRO transactions

Corporate Tax Registration Now Linked to Trade License Renewal

The Federal Tax Authority requires persons subject to corporate tax to register and get a corporate tax registration number.

The FTA also identifies trade license renewal or amendment as a company-record change that requires notification to the authority.

So keep the company's trade license information and FTA registration records updated before getting started on the renewal process. A corporate PRO provider can coordinate that licensing paperwork for you.

WPS Compliance Threshold Change

Since 1 June 2026, the WPS compliance threshold has increased from 80% to 85% of total wages due.

Employers must pay wages through WPS or another MOHRE-approved system in accordance with the updated requirements. The change replaced the previous 80% threshold.

This gives payroll and HR teams less room for administrative errors.

A PRO provider that also handles labour-related submissions can support document preparation, government follow-up, and related company records, although the employer remains responsible for meeting its wage obligations.

UAE PASS and the Shift to Digital PRO Transactions

The UAE Pass is a major part of digital access to UAE government services, as it:

  • provides a national digital identity
  • allows users to access services and sign documents digitally
  • supports the UAE's wider move away from paper-based government transactions

Digitalisation changes how PRO work is performed. Businesses still need someone who:

  • understands which portal to use
  • which documents to submit
  • how to track applications
  • how to resolve rejected or incomplete transactions

Key Functions of Corporate PRO Services

Corporate PRO providers can act as a company's government liaison services UAE partner across several recurring administrative areas. The exact scope depends on the company's legal structure, jurisdiction, workforce, and service agreement.

Visa and Immigration Processing

Corporate PRO support can cover employee, investor, partner, dependent, and other eligible visa processes. This may include new applications, renewals, cancellations, document preparation, status follow-up, and coordination with immigration authorities.

For investor-related requirements, read our Dubai investor visa guide.

For employee and residence visa renewals, check out the Dubai visa renewal guide.

At KPM PRO, our visa services cover employee and investor applications, renewals, cancellations, work permits, and residence visas.

Trade Licensing and Business Setup

PRO support can include trade license applications, renewals, amendments, company formation paperwork, and coordination with the relevant licensing authority.

Businesses can also use PRO support when managing establishment records alongside their license. We provide establishment card renewal services and identify the establishment card as an immigration record used for employee visas and immigration-related transactions.

Read more about trade license types in Dubai and UAE establishment cards.

Document Attestation

Corporate transactions may require commercial, educational, professional, or other documents to be authenticated before they can be used in the UAE.

A PRO provider can coordinate document collection, notarisation, MOFA attestation, consular requirements, and related submissions. Our attestation service covers personal, educational, professional, and commercial documents.

See the Dubai document attestation guide and NOC guide for related documentation requirements.

Labour and MOHRE Compliance

Corporate PRO support may include work permit applications and renewals, labour-related submissions, employment contract amendments, establishment records, and WPS-related administrative requirements.

The 2026 WPS changes make accurate payroll-related administration particularly important. Employers must still meet their own wage payment obligations, but a PRO provider can assist with related government procedures and documentation.

Mainland vs. Free Zone: How Corporate PRO Needs Differ

The government touchpoints involved in PRO work depend heavily on where the company is registered.

Mainland Company PRO Requirements

A Dubai mainland company may interact with several authorities depending on the transaction. Licensing matters fall under Dubai's economic authority, whereas labour matters can involve MOHRE, and immigration matters can involve GDRFA Dubai.

This means one employee-related process involves several records, applications, or approvals. PRO support can coordinate these requirements instead of leaving it up to HR to manage each government interaction separately.

Free Zone Company PRO Requirements

Free zone companies deal with their relevant free zone authority for licensing and company administration. Immigration and labour requirements can still involve federal or other government entity approvals depending on the company's activity, workforce, and zone. But free zone PRO work is not identical across the UAE. Each authority can have its own application process, documentation, fees, and service channels.

A provider working with mainland and free zone companies should be able to explain which authority handles each transaction before submitting an application.

How Much Do Corporate PRO Services Cost in Dubai?

Corporate PRO pricing depends on several factors, including:

  • employee count
  • transaction volume
  • jurisdiction
  • service scope
  • monthly retainer vs. individual handling fee

*These figures are not government tariffs. The actual amount can change based on the transaction, authority, company classification, urgency, and documents required.

For a more detailed outlook, check out our article on PRO services cost in Dubai.

Why Outsource PRO Services Instead of Hiring In-House?

Outsourcing PRO services can give a business access to specialist administrative support without adding a full-time PRO position to its payroll.

An in-house employee involves salary, benefits, recruitment, leave, training, and other employment costs.

For companies with occasional or moderate government transactions, an outsourced arrangement can provide support based on actual workload. Businesses with high transaction volumes eventually decide that an internal team is more suitable.

Compliance is another important factor to consider. As the 2026 WPS threshold moved from 80% to 85%, corporate tax registration now needs to be considered alongside licensing administration. These changes make accurate records and timely government submissions more important instead of simply having someone available to complete paperwork.

How to Choose a Corporate PRO Services Provider in Dubai

A good PRO provider should be able to explain exactly what it handles, which authorities it works with, and what you will pay for each service.

Do not compare providers only on the headline monthly fee. Compare the scope behind that number.

Questions You Should Ask Before Signing a Retainer

Ask these questions before entering into a PRO services agreement:

  • Is pricing itemised?
  • Can we track applications?
  • Who is our point of contact?
  • Do you handle both mainland and free zone companies?
  • What is included in the retainer?
  • How are rejected applications handled?

KPM Pro: Corporate PRO Services for Businesses in Dubai

At KPM PRO, we provide corporate PRO support covering company formation, government approvals, visa processing, trade license renewal, attestation, legal translation, notary services, and related government procedures.

If you are a business managing recurring visa, licensing, immigration, labour, and document requirements, request a custom quote based on your jurisdiction, employee count, transaction volume, and required services.

FAQs

What are corporate PRO services in Dubai, UAE?

They are professional government liaison and compliance services for established companies.

How do corporate PRO services differ from individual PRO services?

Corporate services handle high-volume tasks like mass visa processing, renewals, and company-wide compliance.

Can outsourcing PRO services help reduce business costs?

Yes. Outsourcing eliminates the need for internal admin teams while improving efficiency.

Can corporate PROs handle employee visa processing and renewals?

Yes. They manage every stage of visa processing for large teams.

How do corporate PRO services ensure compliance with UAE labor laws?

They monitor regulation updates and ensure your company stays aligned with legal requirements.

Can corporate PRO services assist with investor and partner visa applications?

Yes. They support applications, renewals, and required approvals.
